fields.statement: At fc4648cb ran go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestUsageHold' -count=1: TestUsageHoldProjection, TestUsageHoldStopsLaunches, TestUsageHoldStopsEveryLaunch and the new TestUsageHoldLiveRunRemaining pass. The new test uses fake journals (three finished runs of 1000, window use 100): no live run projects 1100, a live run at 600 projects 1500 (adds 400), one at 1500 projects 1100 (adds 0), the next pick adds one full mean, and at limit 1500 a live run past the mean no longer holds (the old full-mean-per-live-run count gave 2100). Read the diff: usageHoldOf now adds max(mean - usageRunTokens(st), 0) per live run plus one mean, usageRunTokens counts session and helper input+output+cache creation the same way usageRunMean does, and the result is the Projected field that usageHoldDetail prints. go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/usage-hold also passes.
